title: BIS Publishes IS 20201:2026 Standard for Community Seed Bank Management
summary: Establishes India's 1st management framework for community-led seed banks.

blocks.content: Establishes India's 1st management framework for community-led seed banks.

items: New Standard: Published by BIS Biodiversity Sectional Committee (EED 06) under Environment Department.
NFSNM Support: National Food Security and Nutrition Mission provides ₹50 lakh one-time assistance for community seed banks.
Statutory Protection: Aligns with PPV&FRA 2001 and Biological Diversity Act 2002.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Director General: Sanjay Garg | Est 2016.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
